server.name: DotNet Projects Types Explorer MCP Server

tools.name: NuGetPackageVersions
tools.description: Retrieves version history and dependency information for a specific NuGet package.

packageId.description: The package ID to get versions for

fullTextFiltersWithWildCardSupport.description: Full text filters with wildcard support

tools.name: ReferencedAssembliesExplorer
tools.description: Retrieves referenced assemblies based on filters and pagination (doesn't extract data from referenced projects. Notice that the project must be built before scanning.

projectFileAbsolutePath.description: The absolute path to the project file (.csproj)

fullTextFiltersWithWildCardSupport.description: Full text filters with wildcard support (e.g., 'System.*', '*Json*')

tools.name: NuGetPackageSearch
tools.description: Searches for NuGet packages on nuget.org with support for filtering and pagination.

searchQuery.description: The search query to find packages

includePrerelease.description: Include prerelease versions in search results

fullTextFiltersWithWildCardSupport.description: Full text filters with wildcard support

tools.name: NamespacesExplorer
tools.description: Retrieves namespaces from specified assemblies supporting filters and pagination (doesn't extract data from referenced projects. Notice that the project must be built before scanning.

projectFileAbsolutePath.description: The absolute path to the project file (.csproj)

assemblyNames.description: The assembly names to filter by (without exe/dll extension). If empty, all assemblies are considered

fullTextFiltersWithWildCardSupport.description: Full text filters with wildcard support (e.g., 'System.*', '*Json*')

tools.name: NamespaceTypes
tools.description: Retrieves types from specified namespaces supporting filters and pagination.

projectFileAbsolutePath.description: The absolute path to the project file (.csproj)

namespaces.description: The namespaces to filter by. If empty, all namespaces are considered

fullTextFiltersWithWildCardSupport.description: Full text filters with wildcard support (e.g., '*Controller', 'Service*')
